title: _process
description: A named definition of a process: the subtasks a parent task is split into, who does each one and what each one waits for. The engine creates the subtasks from it. Approval is not part of it: it belongs to the parent task. Draft v0.

subtasks.description: May be omitted on input; normalization sets it to [].

name.description: Name of the subtask, such as WORK or REVIEW. Unique in the process.

role.description: The role that does the subtask.

dependOn.description: Names of the subtasks of this process that must be DONE before this one starts. Subtasks that do not depend on each other run in parallel.

instructions.description: Default instructions of the subtask, as a template. The creator of the parent task can override them with `customInstructions`.
